headline: Country risk rises again and in the City they believe the worst has not yet been seen
summary: Argentina's country risk index rose to 512 points and has deteriorated 19% so far in August. The article discusses the reasons behind the rise and market expectations toward 2027.
why: Country risk measures the extra yield investors demand to hold a government's debt, and it affects borrowing costs and capital flows for Argentina.
why_moved: The index has deteriorated 19% in August and climbed to 512 points, which the article links to rising risk perceptions in the market.
